SQL_NonDB_number-00054-pre.question: Find the name and rank of the 3 youngest winners across all matches.

SQL_NonDB_number-00054-post.question: Find the name and rank of the 5 youngest winners across all matches.

top-n-pair-pre.question: Across all matches, return the 3 distinct name-and-rank combinations of winners with the lowest age recorded for each combination. Output winner name and rank.
top-n-pair-pre.gold_sql: SELECT winner_name, winner_rank FROM (SELECT winner_name, winner_rank, winner_age, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY winner_name, winner_rank ORDER BY winner_age) AS rn FROM matches WHERE winner_age IS NOT NULL) WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY winner_age, winner_name, winner_rank LIMIT 3

top-n-pair-post.question: Across all matches, return the 5 distinct name-and-rank combinations of winners with the lowest age recorded for each combination. Output winner name and rank.
top-n-pair-post.gold_sql: SELECT winner_name, winner_rank FROM (SELECT winner_name, winner_rank, winner_age, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY winner_name, winner_rank ORDER BY winner_age) AS rn FROM matches WHERE winner_age IS NOT NULL) WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY winner_age, winner_name, winner_rank LIMIT 5

top-n-person-pre.question: Find the 3 youngest distinct individual players to win a match. Return one row per player ID, with the name and rank from their youngest recorded win. If a player has multiple wins at that age, use the earliest tournament date and lowest match number.
top-n-person-pre.gold_sql: SELECT m.winner_name, m.winner_rank FROM matches AS m WHERE m.winner_age IS NOT NULL AND m.rowid = (SELECT a.rowid FROM matches AS a WHERE a.winner_id=m.winner_id AND a.winner_age IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a.winner_age, a.tourney_date, a.match_num, a.rowid LIMIT 1) ORDER BY m.winner_age, m.winner_id LIMIT 3

top-n-person-post.question: Find the 5 youngest distinct individual players to win a match. Return one row per player ID, with the name and rank from their youngest recorded win. If a player has multiple wins at that age, use the earliest tournament date and lowest match number.
top-n-person-post.gold_sql: SELECT m.winner_name, m.winner_rank FROM matches AS m WHERE m.winner_age IS NOT NULL AND m.rowid = (SELECT a.rowid FROM matches AS a WHERE a.winner_id=m.winner_id AND a.winner_age IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a.winner_age, a.tourney_date, a.match_num, a.rowid LIMIT 1) ORDER BY m.winner_age, m.winner_id LIMIT 5

NLQ_column_attribute-00104-pre.question: What is the description of the treatment type that costs the least money in total?
NLQ_column_attribute-00104-pre.gold_sql: SELECT T1.treatment_type_description FROM Treatment_types AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.treatment_type_code = T2.treatment_type_code GROUP BY T1.treatment_type_code ORDER BY sum(cost_of_treatment) ASC LIMIT 1

NLQ_column_attribute-00104-post.question: What is the description of the treatment type that is the cheapest in total?

SQL_comparison-00134-pre.question: What are the names of countries that speak more than 2 languages, as well as how many languages they speak?
SQL_comparison-00134-pre.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T2.Language) , T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode GROUP BY T1.Name HAVING COUNT(*) > 2

SQL_comparison-00134-post.question: What are the names of countries that speak at least 2 languages, as well as how many languages they speak?
SQL_comparison-00134-post.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T2.Language) , T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode GROUP BY T1.Name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
